decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ introduction already fully represents card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay support without requiring existing crypto or a wallet.
Adding fiat payment methods and allowing walletless buyers does not change the mint price or revenue-allocation amounts.
The supported payment methods do not change the identity of the minted asset, and the source does not specify a different fulfillment mechanism.
The fiat on-ramp decision concerns primary-mint payment access and does not alter the required flat secondary-sale royalty.
Walletless fiat minting does not necessarily change the optional confirmation email or its contents.
Payment-method support does not change the NFT mint number's role as the permanent referral code or its display locations.
The added fiat payment methods do not change which sale types fund the prize pools or the funding duration.
Fiat payment accessibility does not alter referral badge thresholds or award conditions.
The fiat on-ramp decision neither resumes nor otherwise changes the deferred Discord community server requirement.
Allowing minting without an existing wallet does not necessarily change the manual prize-claim workflow.
Supported mint payment methods do not alter Chainlink VRF winner selection, fairness, or verification.
The existing no-auth rule for public referral statistics remains valid regardless of fiat payment methods or buyer wallet possession.
